const STORAGE_KEYS = [
  "newsletters",
  "events",
  "staff",
  "officeContact",
  "lunchMenu",
  "attendanceInfo",
  "handbookContent",
  "handbookFullLink",
  "handbookSlidesLink",
];

const DEFAULTS = {
  newsletters: [],
  events: [],
  staff: [],
  officeContact: { phone: "", email: "", hours: "" },
  lunchMenu: [],
  attendanceInfo: {
    earlyDismissal: "",
    lateArrival: "",
    attendance: "",
  },
  handbookContent: "",
  handbookFullLink: "",
  handbookSlidesLink: "",
};

function useStorage() {
  const [data, setData] = useState(DEFAULTS);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      const results = await Promise.allSettled(
        STORAGE_KEYS.map((key) => window.storage.get(key, true))
      );
      if (cancelled) return;
      const next = { ...DEFAULTS };
      results.forEach((r, i) => {
        const key = STORAGE_KEYS[i];
        if (r.status === "fulfilled" && r.value && r.value.value) {
          try {
            next[key] = JSON.parse(r.value.value);
          } catch (err) {
            /* leave default if parse fails */
          }
        }
      });
      setData(next);
      setLoading(false);
    })();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  const save = useCallback(async (key, value) => {
    setData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }));
    try {
      const result = await window.storage.set(key, JSON.stringify(value), true);
      if (!result) setErrorMsg("That didn't save. Check your connection and try again.");
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMsg("That didn't save. Check your connection and try again.");
    }
  }, []);

  return { data, loading, errorMsg, setErrorMsg, save };
}

function uid() {
  return Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
}

function formatDateLabel(iso) {
  const d = new Date(iso + "T00:00:00");
  if (isNaN(d)) return iso;
  return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" });
}

function toISODate(d) {
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
}

const CARD_ROTATIONS = [-2.5, 1.8, -1.2, 2.6, -1.8, 1.1, -2.2, 1.6];

/* ---------- Lion cub mascot ---------- */

/* ---------- shared bits ---------- */

function Modal({ onClose, children }) {
  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4"
      style={{ background: "rgba(18,48,85,0.55)" }}
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

function FormShell({ title, onClose, onSubmit, children, cta, ctaColor }) {
  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={onSubmit}
      className="shub-card p-5 flex flex-col gap-3 shub-scroll"
      style={{ minWidth: 280, maxWidth: 380, maxHeight: "85vh", overflowY: "auto" }}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h4 className="shub-display text-xl">{title}</h4>
        <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close" className="shub-btn">
          <X size={18} />
        </button>
      </div>
      {children}
      <button
        type="submit"
        className="shub-btn rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm text-white mt-1"
        style={{ background: ctaColor || "var(--pin-red)" }}
      >
        {cta}
      </button>
    </form>
  );
}

/* Inline editable text block (used for attendance policy notes) */
function EditableNote({ label, value, placeholder, onSave, adminMode, rows = 5 }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(value);

  useEffect(() => setDraft(value), [value]);

  return (
    <div className="shub-card p-5 relative" style={{ minHeight: 160 }}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
        <h4 className="shub-display text-xl">{label}</h4>
        {adminMode && !editing && (
          <button
            className="shub-btn p-1"
            aria-label={`Edit ${label}`}
            onClick={() => setEditing(true)}
            style={{ color: "var(--accent-blue)" }}
          >
            <Pencil size={15} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {editing ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <textarea
            className="shub-input"
            rows={rows}
            value={draft}
            onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
            placeholder={placeholder}
          />
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button
              className="shub-btn rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white"
              style={{ background: "var(--accent-blue)" }}
              onClick={() => {
                onSave(draft);
                setEditing(false);
              }}
            >
              Save
            </button>
            <button
              className="shub-btn rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs"
              style={{ border: "2px solid rgba(18,48,85,0.2)" }}
              onClick={() => {
                setDraft(value);
                setEditing(false);
              }}
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : value ? (
        <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-line" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>
          {value}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-sm italic" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>
          {adminMode ? "Nothing written yet — tap the pencil to add it." : "Nothing posted yet."}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------- Newsletters ---------- */

function NewsletterCard({ item, index, adminMode, onDelete }) {
  const rot = CARD_ROTATIONS[index % CARD_ROTATIONS.length];
  return (
    <div className="shub-card relative p-5 flex flex-col gap-2" style={{ transform: `rotate(${rot}deg)`, minHeight: 180 }}>
      <div className="shub-pin" style={{ top: -9, left: "50%", marginLeft: -8.5, position: "absolute" }} aria-hidden="true" />
      <span className="shub-mono text-xs" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>{formatDateLabel(item.date)}</span>
      <h3 className="shub-display text-2xl leading-tight">{item.title}</h3>
      {item.summary && <p className="text-sm leading-snug flex-1" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>{item.summary}</p>}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2">
        {item.link ? (
          <a href={item.link} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold" style={{ color: "var(--accent-blue)" }}>
            Open newsletter <ExternalLink size={14} />
          </a>
        ) : (
          <span className="text-xs italic" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>No link attached</span>
        )}
        {adminMode && (
          <button className="shub-btn p-1.5 rounded" aria-label={`Remove ${item.title}`} onClick={() => onDelete(item.id)} style={{ color: "var(--pin-red-dark)" }}>
            <Trash2 size={16} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function AddNewsletterForm({ onAdd, onClose }) {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [date, setDate] = useState(() => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10));
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState("");
  const [link, setLink] = useState("");

  function submit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!title.trim()) return;
    onAdd({ id: uid(), title: title.trim(), date, summary: summary.trim(), link: link.trim() });
    onClose();
  }

  return (
    <FormShell title="Pin a newsletter" onClose={onClose} onSubmit={submit} cta="Pin to board">
      <label className="shub-label">Title
        <input className="shub-input" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} required placeholder="Week of Sept 8 Newsletter" />
      </label>
      <label className="shub-label">Date
        <input type="date" className="shub-input shub-mono" value={date} onChange={(e) => setDate(e.target.value)} />
      </label>
      <label className="shub-label">Short summary (optional)
        <textarea className="shub-input" rows={3} value={summary} onChange={(e) => setSummary(e.target.value)} placeholder="Picture day, book fair, and this week's spelling list." />
      </label>
      <label className="shub-label">Link to full newsletter (optional)
        <input className="shub-input" value={link} onChange={(e) => setLink(e.target.value)} placeholder="https://..." />
      </label>
    </FormShell>
  );
}

  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [date, setDate] = useState(defaultDate);
  const [time, setTime] = useState("");
  const [location, setLocation] = useState("");
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");

  function submit(e) {

    onAdd({ id: uid(), title: title.trim(), date, time: time.trim(), location: location.trim(), note: note.trim() });

  return (
    <FormShell title="Add to the calendar" onClose={onClose} onSubmit={submit} cta="Add event" ctaColor="var(--accent-blue)">

        </label>

          <input type="time" className="shub-input shub-mono" value={time} onChange={(e) => setTime(e.target.value)} />

      <label className="shub-label">Note (optional)

      </label>
    </FormShell>

function CalendarView({ events, adminMode, onAddEvent, onDeleteEvent }) {
  const today = useMemo(() => new Date(), []);
  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState(new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), 1));
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(toISODate(today));
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);

  const eventsByDate = useMemo(() => {
    const map = {};
    events.forEach((e) => {
      if (!map[e.date]) map[e.date] = [];
      map[e.date].push(e);
    });
    return map;
  }, [events]);

  const year = cursor.getFullYear();
  const month = cursor.getMonth();
  const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1);
  const startOffset = firstDay.getDay();
  const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();

  const cells = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < startOffset; i++) cells.push(null);
  for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) cells.push(d);

  const monthLabel = cursor.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: "long", year: "numeric" });
  const selectedEvents = (eventsByDate[selected] || []).slice().sort((a, b) => (a.time || "").localeCompare(b.time || ""));

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="shub-card p-4">
        <h3 className="shub-display text-2xl mb-3">School Calendar</h3>
        <div style={{ position: "relative", width: "100%", paddingBottom: "75%", borderRadius: 10, overflow: "hidden" }}>
          <iframe
            title="WPSD Elementary Google Calendar"
            src="https://calendar.google.com/calendar/embed?src=c_5f1bd5ef8bad13471f2f5aa1bd650d813e2da85fa6fff262c7b2ee7c0b2da593%40group.calendar.google.com&ctz=America%2FNew_York"
            style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, left: 0, width: "100%", height: "100%", border: 0 }}
            frameBorder="0"
            scrolling="no"
          />
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs mt-2" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>
          This pulls live from the school's Google Calendar — add or edit events there and they'll show up here automatically.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="shub-card relative overflow-visible" style={{ padding: "28px 20px 20px" }}>
        <div className="shub-tape" style={{ top: -14, left: "12%", width: 90, transform: "rotate(-4deg)" }} aria-hidden="true" />
        <div className="shub-tape" style={{ top: -14, right: "12%", width: 90, transform: "rotate(3deg)" }} aria-hidden="true" />
        <h4 className="shub-display text-xl mb-2" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>Quick-add highlights</h4>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <button className="shub-btn p-2 rounded-full text-white" style={{ background: "var(--accent-blue)" }} onClick={() => setCursor(new Date(year, month - 1, 1))} aria-label="Previous month">
            <ChevronLeft size={18} />
          </button>
          <h3 className="shub-display text-3xl">{monthLabel}</h3>
          <button className="shub-btn p-2 rounded-full text-white" style={{ background: "var(--accent-blue)" }} onClick={() => setCursor(new Date(year, month + 1, 1))} aria-label="Next month">
            <ChevronRight size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1 mb-1">
          {["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"].map((d) => (
            <div key={d} className="shub-mono text-center text-[11px] py-1" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>{d}</div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
          {cells.map((d, i) => {
            if (d === null) return <div key={`empty-${i}`} />;
            const iso = toISODate(new Date(year, month, d));
            const dayEvents = eventsByDate[iso] || [];
            const isToday = iso === toISODate(today);
            const isSelected = iso === selected;
            return (
              <button
                key={iso}
                onClick={() => setSelected(iso)}
                className="shub-day relative rounded-lg flex flex-col items-center justify-start pt-1 pb-1"
                style={{
                  aspectRatio: "1 / 1",
                  background: isSelected ? "var(--gold)" : "transparent",
                  border: isToday ? "2px solid var(--pin-red)" : "1px solid var(--paper-line)",
                  cursor: "pointer",
                }}
              >
                <span className="shub-mono text-xs">{d}</span>
                {dayEvents.length > 0 && (
                  <span className="mt-1 rounded-full" style={{ width: 6, height: 6, background: isSelected ? "var(--ink)" : "var(--accent-blue)" }} />
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h4 className="shub-display text-2xl" style={{ color: "var(--card)" }}>{formatDateLabel(selected)}</h4>
          {adminMode && (
            <button onClick={() => setShowForm(true)} className="shub-btn inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-white" style={{ background: "var(--accent-blue)" }}>
              <Plus size={14} /> Add event
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        {selectedEvents.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm italic" style={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)" }}>Nothing on the calendar for this day yet.</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            {selectedEvents.map((e) => (
              <li key={e.id} className="shub-card px-4 py-3 flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div>
                  <p className="font-semibold text-sm">{e.title}</p>
                  <p className="shub-mono text-xs mt-0.5" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>
                    {e.time ? e.time : "All day"}{e.location ? ` · ${e.location}` : ""}
                  </p>
                  {e.note && <p className="text-xs mt-1" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>{e.note}</p>}
                </div>
                {adminMode && (
                  <button className="shub-btn p-1" aria-label={`Remove ${e.title}`} onClick={() => onDeleteEvent(e.id)} style={{ color: "var(--pin-red-dark)" }}>
                    <Trash2 size={15} />
                  </button>
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>

      {showForm && (
        <Modal onClose={() => setShowForm(false)}>
          <AddEventForm defaultDate={selected} onAdd={onAddEvent} onClose={() => setShowForm(false)} />
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------- Communication ---------- */

function EditOfficeContactForm({ value, onSave, onClose }) {
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(value.phone);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(value.email);
  const [hours, setHours] = useState(value.hours);

  function submit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    onSave({ phone: phone.trim(), email: email.trim(), hours: hours.trim() });
    onClose();
  }

  return (
    <FormShell title="Front office info" onClose={onClose} onSubmit={submit} cta="Save" ctaColor="var(--accent-blue)">
      <label className="shub-label">Phone
        <input className="shub-input" value={phone} onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)} placeholder="(555) 123-4567" />
      </label>
      <label className="shub-label">Email
        <input className="shub-input" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} placeholder="office@wpsd.edu" />
      </label>
      <label className="shub-label">Office hours
        <input className="shub-input" value={hours} onChange={(e) => setHours(e.target.value)} placeholder="Mon–Fri, 7:30am–4pm" />
      </label>
    </FormShell>
  );
}

function AddStaffForm({ onAdd, onClose }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [role, setRole] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");

  function submit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!name.trim()) return;
    onAdd({ id: uid(), name: name.trim(), role: role.trim(), email: email.trim(), note: note.trim() });
    onClose();
  }

  return (
    <FormShell title="Add a staff contact" onClose={onClose} onSubmit={submit} cta="Add contact" ctaColor="var(--accent-blue)">
      <label className="shub-label">Name
        <input className="shub-input" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} required placeholder="Ms. Rivera" />
      </label>
      <label className="shub-label">Role
        <input className="shub-input" value={role} onChange={(e) => setRole(e.target.value)} placeholder="2nd Grade Teacher" />
      </label>
      <label className="shub-label">Email
        <input className="shub-input" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} placeholder="rivera@wpsd.edu" />
      </label>
      <label className="shub-label">Best way to reach (optional)
        <input className="shub-input" value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} placeholder="Email is fastest; replies within a day" />
      </label>
    </FormShell>
  );
}

function CommunicationTab({ data, adminMode, save }) {
  const [showContactForm, setShowContactForm] = useState(false);
  const [showStaffForm, setShowStaffForm] = useState(false);
  const { officeContact, staff } = data;

  function deleteStaff(id) {
    save("staff", staff.filter((s) => s.id !== id));
  }

  const hasContact = officeContact.phone || officeContact.email || officeContact.hours;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
      <div className="shub-card p-5 relative">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
          <h4 className="shub-display text-2xl">Front office</h4>
          {adminMode && (
            <button className="shub-btn p-1" aria-label="Edit office contact" onClick={() => setShowContactForm(true)} style={{ color: "var(--accent-blue)" }}>
              <Pencil size={15} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        {hasContact ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm">
            {officeContact.phone && <p className="flex items-center gap-2"><Phone size={14} /> {officeContact.phone}</p>}
            {officeContact.email && <p className="flex items-center gap-2"><Mail size={14} /> {officeContact.email}</p>}
            {officeContact.hours && <p className="flex items-center gap-2"><Clock size={14} /> {officeContact.hours}</p>}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-sm italic" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>
            {adminMode ? "Add a phone number, email, or office hours." : "Contact info coming soon."}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h4 className="shub-display text-2xl" style={{ color: "var(--card)" }}>Staff directory</h4>
          {adminMode && (
            <button onClick={() => setShowStaffForm(true)} className="shub-btn inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-white" style={{ background: "var(--pin-red)" }}>
              <Plus size={16} /> Add contact
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        {staff.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm italic" style={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)" }}>
            No staff contacts yet. {adminMode ? "Add the first one above." : ""}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {staff.map((s, i) => (
              <div key={s.id} className="shub-card relative p-5" style={{ transform: `rotate(${CARD_ROTATIONS[i % CARD_ROTATIONS.length]}deg)` }}>
                <div className="shub-pin" style={{ top: -9, left: "50%", marginLeft: -8.5, position: "absolute" }} aria-hidden="true" />
                <h5 className="shub-display text-xl leading-tight">{s.name}</h5>
                {s.role && <p className="text-xs font-semibold mt-0.5" style={{ color: "var(--accent-blue)" }}>{s.role}</p>}
                {s.email && <p className="text-sm mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5"><Mail size={13} /> {s.email}</p>}
                {s.note && <p className="text-xs mt-2" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>{s.note}</p>}
                {adminMode && (
                  <button className="shub-btn p-1 mt-2" aria-label={`Remove ${s.name}`} onClick={() => deleteStaff(s.id)} style={{ color: "var(--pin-red-dark)" }}>
                    <Trash2 size={15} />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {showContactForm && (
        <Modal onClose={() => setShowContactForm(false)}>
          <EditOfficeContactForm value={officeContact} onSave={(v) => save("officeContact", v)} onClose={() => setShowContactForm(false)} />
        </Modal>
      )}
      {showStaffForm && (
        <Modal onClose={() => setShowStaffForm(false)}>
          <AddStaffForm onAdd={(s) => save("staff", [...staff, s])} onClose={() => setShowStaffForm(false)} />
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------- Lunch menu ---------- */

function AddLunchForm({ onAdd, onClose }) {
  const [date, setDate] = useState(() => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10));
  const [items, setItems] = useState("");
  const [allergens, setAllergens] = useState("");

  function submit(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!items.trim()) return;
    onAdd({ id: uid(), date, items: items.trim(), allergens: allergens.trim() });
    onClose();
  }

  return (
    <FormShell title="Add a lunch menu day" onClose={onClose} onSubmit={submit} cta="Add to menu" ctaColor="var(--green)">
      <label className="shub-label">Date
        <input type="date" className="shub-input shub-mono" value={date} onChange={(e) => setDate(e.target.value)} />
      </label>
      <label className="shub-label">What's being served
        <textarea className="shub-input" rows={2} value={items} onChange={(e) => setItems(e.target.value)} required placeholder="Chicken tenders, green beans, fruit cup" />
      </label>
      <label className="shub-label">Allergen notes (optional)
        <input className="shub-input" value={allergens} onChange={(e) => setAllergens(e.target.value)} placeholder="Contains dairy, gluten" />
      </label>
    </FormShell>
  );
}

function LunchMenuTab({ lunchMenu, adminMode, save }) {
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const todayIso = toISODate(new Date());

  const sorted = useMemo(() => [...lunchMenu].sort((a, b) => (a.date < b.date ? -1 : 1)), [lunchMenu]);
  const upcoming = sorted.filter((m) => m.date >= todayIso);
  const past = sorted.filter((m) => m.date < todayIso);

  function deleteItem(id) {
    save("lunchMenu", lunchMenu.filter((m) => m.id !== id));
  }

  function renderRow(m, isNext) {
    return (
      <li
        key={m.id}
        className="shub-card px-4 py-3 flex items-start justify-between gap-3"
        style={{ borderLeft: isNext ? "5px solid var(--green)" : undefined }}
      >
        <div>
          <p className="shub-mono text-xs" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>
            {formatDateLabel(m.date)} {isNext && <span style={{ color: "var(--green)", fontWeight: 700 }}> · UP NEXT</span>}
          </p>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold mt-1">{m.items}</p>
          {m.allergens && <p className="text-xs mt-1" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>Allergens: {m.allergens}</p>}
        </div>
        {adminMode && (
          <button className="shub-btn p-1" aria-label="Remove menu day" onClick={() => deleteItem(m.id)} style={{ color: "var(--pin-red-dark)" }}>
            <Trash2 size={15} />
          </button>
        )}
      </li>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      {adminMode && (
        <div className="flex justify-center">
          <button onClick={() => setShowForm(true)} className="shub-btn inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-white" style={{ background: "var(--green)" }}>
            <Plus size={16} /> Add menu day
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {sorted.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-center text-sm py-10" style={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)" }}>
          No lunch menu posted yet. {adminMode ? "Add the first day above." : "Check back soon."}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            {upcoming.map((m, i) => renderRow(m, i === 0))}
          </ul>
          {past.length > 0 && (
            <details>
              <summary className="text-sm cursor-pointer" style={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)" }}>
                Past menu days ({past.length})
              </summary>
              <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2 mt-2">
                {past.slice().reverse().map((m) => renderRow(m, false))}
              </ul>
            </details>
          )}
        </>
      )}
      {showForm && (
        <Modal onClose={() => setShowForm(false)}>
          <AddLunchForm onAdd={(m) => save("lunchMenu", [...lunchMenu, m])} onClose={() => setShowForm(false)} />
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------- Attendance ---------- */

function AttendanceTab({ attendanceInfo, adminMode, save }) {
  function update(field, value) {
    save("attendanceInfo", { ...attendanceInfo, [field]: value });
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
      <EditableNote
        label="Reporting an absence"
        value={attendanceInfo.attendance}
        placeholder="Call the office by 9am at (555) 123-4567, or email attendance@wpsd.edu."
        onSave={(v) => update("attendance", v)}
        adminMode={adminMode}
      />
      <EditableNote
        label="Late arrival"
        value={attendanceInfo.lateArrival}
        placeholder="Students arriving after 8:15am should be signed in at the front office."
        onSave={(v) => update("lateArrival", v)}
        adminMode={adminMode}
      />
      <EditableNote
        label="Early dismissal"
        value={attendanceInfo.earlyDismissal}
        placeholder="Send a written note and pick up at the front office; photo ID required."
        onSave={(v) => update("earlyDismissal", v)}
        adminMode={adminMode}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------- Handbook tab ---------- */

function LinkField({ label, url, adminMode, onSave, placeholder }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(url);

  useEffect(() => setDraft(url), [url]);

  return (
    <div className="shub-card p-5 flex-1" style={{ minWidth: 220 }}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
        <h5 className="shub-display text-lg">{label}</h5>
        {adminMode && !editing && (
          <button className="shub-btn p-1" aria-label={`Edit ${label}`} onClick={() => setEditing(true)} style={{ color: "var(--accent-blue)" }}>
            <Pencil size={14} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
      {editing ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <input className="shub-input" value={draft} onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)} placeholder={placeholder} autoFocus />
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button
              className="shub-btn rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white"
              style={{ background: "var(--accent-blue)" }}
              onClick={() => { onSave(draft.trim()); setEditing(false); }}
            >
              Save
            </button>
            <button className="shub-btn rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs" style={{ border: "2px solid rgba(18,48,85,0.2)" }} onClick={() => { setDraft(url); setEditing(false); }}>
              Cancel
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : url ? (
        <a href={url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm font-semibold" style={{ color: "var(--accent-blue)" }}>
          Open link <ExternalLink size={14} />
        </a>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-sm italic" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>
          {adminMode ? "Not added yet — tap the pencil to paste a link." : "Not posted yet."}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function HandbookTab({ data, adminMode, save }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <EditableNote
        label="Elementary handbook"
        value={data.handbookContent}
        placeholder="Cover the elementary-specific basics here: dress code, daily schedule, discipline policy, technology use, and anything else that differs from the district-wide handbook."
        onSave={(v) => save("handbookContent", v)}
        adminMode={adminMode}
        rows={10}
      />
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4">
        <LinkField
          label="Full district handbook"
          url={data.handbookFullLink}
          adminMode={adminMode}
          onSave={(v) => save("handbookFullLink", v)}
          placeholder="https://wpsd.edu/handbook.pdf"
        />
        <LinkField
          label="Summary slides"
          url={data.handbookSlidesLink}
          adminMode={adminMode}
          onSave={(v) => save("handbookSlidesLink", v)}
          placeholder="https://slides-link.com"
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------- App ---------- */

const TABS = [
  { key: "newsletters", label: "Newsletters", icon: Newspaper },
  { key: "calendar", label: "Calendar", icon: CalendarDays },
  { key: "communication", label: "Communication", icon: Users },
  { key: "lunch", label: "Lunch Menu", icon: Utensils },
  { key: "attendance", label: "Attendance", icon: DoorOpen },
  { key: "handbook", label: "Handbook", icon: BookOpen },
];

export default function SchoolHub() {
  const { data, loading, errorMsg, setErrorMsg, save } = useStorage();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("newsletters");
  const [adminMode, setAdminMode] = useState(false);
  const [showNewsletterForm, setShowNewsletterForm] = useState(false);

  const sortedNewsletters = useMemo(
    () => [...data.newsletters].sort((a, b) => (a.date < b.date ? 1 : -1)),
    [data.newsletters]
  );

  return (
    <div className="shub">
      <style>{FONT_IMPORT}</style>
      <style>{TOKENS}</style>

      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        {/* Header banner */}
        <div className="shub-card relative mx-auto mb-4 px-6 py-5 text-center flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-3" style={{ maxWidth: 640, transform: "rotate(-0.6deg)" }}>
          <div className="shub-pin" style={{ top: -9, left: 18 }} aria-hidden="true" />
          <div className="shub-pin" style={{ top: -9, right: 18 }} aria-hidden="true" />
          <LionCub size={100} />
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 mb-1" style={{ color: "var(--accent-blue)" }}>
              <span className="shub-mono text-[11px] tracking-widest uppercase">Home of the Lions · Parent Hub</span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="shub-display text-4xl sm:text-5xl leading-none">WPSD Elementary</h1>
            <p className="text-sm mt-2" style={{ color: "var(--ink-soft)" }}>
              Everything pinned in one place: newsletters, the calendar, and what you need day to day.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Admin toggle */}
        <div className="flex justify-end mb-4">
          <label className="shub-btn inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ background: "rgba(255,255,255,0.95)", color: "var(--ink)" }}>
            <input type="checkbox" checked={adminMode} onChange={(e) => setAdminMode(e.target.checked)} className="accent-current" />
            Admin mode {adminMode ? "on — you can add & remove" : "off — viewing only"}
          </label>
        </div>

        {errorMsg && (
          <div className="shub-card px-4 py-2 mb-4 text-sm" style={{ color: "var(--pin-red-dark)", borderLeft: "4px solid var(--pin-red)" }}>
            {errorMsg}
            <button className="ml-3 underline" onClick={() => setErrorMsg("")}>Dismiss</button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="flex gap-2 mb-6 justify-center flex-wrap">
          {TABS.map(({ key, label, icon: Icon }) => (
            <button
              key={key}
              onClick={() => setTab(key)}
              className="shub-tab shub-btn inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-t-lg text-sm"
              style={{
                background: tab === key ? "var(--card)" : "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)",
                color: "var(--ink)",
                boxShadow: tab === key ? "0 -2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)" : "none",
                fontWeight: tab === key ? 800 : 600,
                border: tab === key ? "3px solid var(--gold)" : "3px solid transparent",
                borderBottom: "none",
              }}
            >
              <Icon size={16} />
              {label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-20" style={{ color: "var(--card)" }}>
            <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={20} />
            <span>Loading the board…</span>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {tab === "newsletters" && (
              <div>
                {adminMode && (
                  <div className="flex justify-center mb-6">
                    <button onClick={() => setShowNewsletterForm(true)} className="shub-btn inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-white" style={{ background: "var(--pin-red)" }}>
                      <Plus size={16} /> Pin a newsletter
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
                {sortedNewsletters.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="text-center text-sm py-16" style={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)" }}>
                    Nothing pinned yet. {adminMode ? "Add the first newsletter above." : "Check back soon."}
                  </p>
                ) : (
                  <div className="grid gap-8 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 pt-2">
                    {sortedNewsletters.map((n, i) => (
                      <NewsletterCard key={n.id} item={n} index={i} adminMode={adminMode} onDelete={(id) => save("newsletters", data.newsletters.filter((x) => x.id !== id))} />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
                {showNewsletterForm && (
                  <Modal onClose={() => setShowNewsletterForm(false)}>
                    <AddNewsletterForm onAdd={(n) => save("newsletters", [n, ...data.newsletters])} onClose={() => setShowNewsletterForm(false)} />
                  </Modal>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {tab === "calendar" && (
              <CalendarView
                events={data.events}
                adminMode={adminMode}
                onAddEvent={(e) => save("events", [...data.events, e])}
                onDeleteEvent={(id) => save("events", data.events.filter((x) => x.id !== id))}
              />
            )}

            {tab === "communication" && <CommunicationTab data={data} adminMode={adminMode} save={save} />}

            {tab === "lunch" && <LunchMenuTab lunchMenu={data.lunchMenu} adminMode={adminMode} save={save} />}

            {tab === "attendance" && <AttendanceTab attendanceInfo={data.attendanceInfo} adminMode={adminMode} save={save} />}

            {tab === "handbook" && <HandbookTab data={data} adminMode={adminMode} save={save} />}
          </>
        )}

        {adminMode && (
          <p className="text-center text-xs mt-10" style={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)" }}>
            Admin mode is a simple on/off switch for this MVP, not a login — anyone who opens this
            page can turn it on. Add real authentication before sharing this widely.
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
